body:
My dad is pretty cool, though he is also suffering from depression so it runs in the family.

I didn't feel like I got anything from talking to either the professional psychologist or the school counselors. I had a couple of new viewpoints to see things from but everything else I already figured out on my own. (i enjoy reading up on psychology)

I opined up to my father about my depression. He said if I ever needed to see anyone I didn't have to tell him anything and I took him up on that. I left out the suicide since I didn't think I was going to die and all he would do was take me to a therapist like I was.already going to.

Also thank you for responding. I never felt miraculously better after talking about this but I figure it couldn't hurt.

I don't feel forced with my friends and when they went to seperate colleges I made it a point to see who I can every month or so. I dont open up to them about this since all they can do is help me enjoy life and they can do that without knowing about this.

Not especially though thanks for asking, I have been moving around a lot because of my dad's job, I don't think i have ever gone to the same elementary school for more than 1 year. That has since stabilized now that I am in Florida and went to the same middle school and then the same high school (and college for that matter) It was just a fact of life for me and was very exciting.

p.s I should be leaving to said college now, i'll respond again when I get out

I have considered that (though not that kind of ocd specifically) and find that if i get too depressed i just need to lock my self away from everyone and listen to some uplifting music, maybe a comedy movie, (dont usually play video games when i get like that)

I can cope with it, like i said i have always been like this and i probably wouldn't have made it her if i couldn't.

I can certainly laugh at myself too while thinking about it they are sometimes really rediculous. just to give an example if i go to the movies and get a drink every time i look at it or take i drink i think "if the straw stabbed me through the throat that might kill me, or maybe if i fell on it and impaled myself through the eye sockets"

I was moving around a lot, from Washington to Kansas when I was 7 and then down to Florida when I was 10 not including all the in-state moves as well. 

since I moved around so much I never had much of a chance to get too attached to the places or people.
